findings.title: Bias-variance decomposition does not impose convex risk
findings.source_claim: The bias-variance tradeoff implies convex predictive error versus complexity and no renewed improvement after deterioration.
findings.suspect_step: Inferring the shape of the sum from the decomposition alone.

counterexample.test_design: independent uniform draw over same four rows
counterexample.models: nested least squares k0..3; k0 predicts0

findings.alternative_reading: Intended familiar U-shaped heuristic, not a formal universal theorem.
findings.supported_impact: Local mathematical premise overstated; central research-value recommendations intact.

repair.statement: Present U-shape as conventional heuristic under additional assumptions; exact decomposition alone gives no convexity or no-recovery guarantee.
repair.verification: Analytic and exact arithmetic support; no empirical repair claimed
